How it works

Check-in in five easy steps.

From the front door to your HR records, everything happens on its own.

Step 1

Arrive

Your team walks in and heads to the reception check-in screen.

Step 2

Step up

Step 3

Look

Step 4

Recognised

FlowPeople greets each person by name, instantly.

Step 5

Done

Attendance is recorded and synced to your HR records.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

How does face check-in work?+

Employees look at the check-in screen at reception. FlowPeople recognises them and records attendance in about two seconds.

Do we need special hardware?+

A simple tablet or screen at your entrance is enough. We help you set it up.

Is employee data safe?+

Yes. Data is protected and access is limited to the people you choose. You stay in control of it.

Does it work for multiple offices?+

Yes. Every location reports into one place, so HR sees the whole picture.

Can it connect to payroll?+

Yes. Attendance, leave and shifts flow into payroll so there is nothing to re-enter.

How long does setup take?+

Most teams are up and running within days, not months.
